name: Clevedon Foodbank
short_description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at Clevedon Methodist Church. Open Mon and Wed for distribution. Referral required.

name: North Somerset Council Allotments
short_description: North Somerset Council allotment sites in Clevedon area
description: Council manages sites at Kennway Road
image: and Walton Down. Plots from £35/year. Waiting lists operate. Includes water access and storage.

name: Clevedon Community Garden
description: Volunteer-run community garden with sea views. Grows seasonal vegetables with harvest shared among volunteers. Open Wed and Sat mornings.
